remarks: Flash point of the LDO to be entered from the fuel data
text: Classification basis: natural gas (methane 85 to 98.5 mol %, gas group IIA, temperature class T1) at the fuel gas station, GT gas skid interface and gas piping; hydrogen (gas group IIC, T1) at the hydrogen sources and the battery rooms (and up to 5 vol % hydrogen admixture in the fuel gas capability of DP-CASE-0021, which shall be assessed as a release of a group IIC constituent for the equipment selection at the gas station); LDO handled below its flash point (DP-EPCE-0013) is not classified except at vents of the tanks (zone 2 in the vent zone); aqueous ammonia 24.5 % (IF-25) is not an explosive atmosphere at ambient conditions unless heated.
